kinetic_cell_cycle_proof.kinetic_law: Steel (1977) Growth Fraction Equation: (1/N) * (dN/dt) = ln(2) * (GF / T_C) * (1 - phi)

parameters.GF: Growth Fraction (fraction of cells in active cycle G1/S/G2/M vs G0 quiescent, quantified by MKI67/PCNA mRNA).
parameters.T_C: Cell cycle duration (typically 24.0 +/- 4.2 hours in breast/lung cancer).

kinetic_cell_cycle_proof.ergodic_ensemble_sampling: Because a solid tumor contains >3,000 to >5,000 spatial spots sampling every frequency combination f in [0, 1]^K across the spatial coordinates Omega, spatial heterogeneity acts as an ergodic ensemble. Measuring instantaneous proliferation w_i across spatial coordinates is mathematically equivalent to measuring temporal evolution from thousands of different initial conditions simultaneously.
